scope: 单张作品提取。原图为用户上传，创作者、原始发表链接及授权未独立核验。画法以可见外观描述。

references.R1: 用户提供的 Bunnies Day Cafe Event 海报，1080 × 1528。 归档文件 reference.jpeg。
references.R1-top: 顶部英文说明及上部两行韩文贴纸标题。
references.R1-bg: 上部蓝色过渡、主体粉色底、浅点纹和底边云形。
references.R1-photo: 中部心形照片窗、粉色衣帽与人物组。
references.R1-prop: 下半部淡蓝色信封、折线、蝴蝶结与两枚短文案条。
references.R1-stickers: 右上、左右中部和两处底角的兔耳人物与大小装饰。

slots.headline: 大标题及其字形特征
slots.container: 承载中心图像的主题纸件
slots.mascots: 同一家族的原创角色贴纸
slots.accents: 桥接相邻版块的小装饰
slots.labels: 补充活动信息的短标签

rules.zh: 将{{headline}}、{{hero}}与{{mascots}}分层拼贴，形成甜酷、俏皮的活动海报。
rules.en: Layer {{headline}}, {{hero}}, and {{mascots}} as a playful, sweet pop event poster.
rules.check: 照片、字形和平涂贴纸三种语言都能辨认。

rules.zh: 以浅粉与天蓝组织大色面。深蓝勾边和浓粉用来强化少数读点，白色分隔图层，浅黄及薄荷绿只作小面积变化。
rules.en: Organize broad areas with pastel pink and sky blue. Use dark-blue outlines and vivid pink for a few focal accents, white to separate layers, and pale yellow and mint as small variations.
rules.check: 缩略图先见粉蓝主关系，浅黄及绿不会变成背景主色。

rules.zh: 让照片呈高明度柔光，接触阴影只用于说明纸件重叠。背景的粉蓝渐变保持柔和。
rules.en: Use bright, softly lit photography and restrict contact shadows to clarifying overlapping paper. Keep the pink-blue background gradient gentle.
rules.check: 人物五官依然可辨，纸件的短阴影不变成长硬投影。

rules.zh: 让{{headline}}占据上部，让{{hero}}嵌进中部的{{container}}，使纸件和边缘贴纸部分交叠。视线从标题向主图，再向纸件及角落移动。
rules.en: Place {{headline}} in the upper area, nest {{hero}} in {{container}} at the center, and let paper overlap some edge stickers. Guide the eye from headline to hero image and on to the paper and edges.
rules.check: 看得到中心图与纸件的遮挡关系，标题或面孔无关键裁切。

rules.zh: 保持大标题和中心图两个大级别，角色贴纸降一档，图标与小标记再小一档。
rules.en: Keep headline and hero image as the two large scale anchors, with smaller character stickers and even smaller icons and accents.
rules.check: 缩小后可同时区分三档尺度。

rules.zh: 角色用深色勾线和低细节平涂，照片保留五官及衣褶；字形可以错落、轻微旋转，并保持一字一读。
rules.en: Use dark outlines and simplified flat fills for characters, retain faces and clothing folds in the photograph, and stagger or slightly rotate letters while keeping every character readable.
rules.check: 字形、平涂角色和摄影质感各自清楚。

rules.zh: 大标题使用深蓝细内描边、浅蓝宽外边与轻微错位投影；轮廓贴纸也使用明显的浅色模切边，但对比低于标题。
rules.en: Give the headline a thin dark-blue inline outline, wide pale-blue outer border and slight offset shadow. Give die-cut stickers visible pale borders at lower contrast than the title.
rules.check: 文字边界连续，角色贴纸的外边与背景分得开。

rules.zh: 脸、主标题和纸件关键折口保留清晰细节，周边符号保持简单剪影。
rules.en: Keep faces, headline and key paper folds clearly resolved, and simplify peripheral symbols to clear silhouettes.
rules.check: 局部细节优先服务于面孔和文字辨读。

rules.zh: 在背景与纸件上加轻微细颗粒和浅点阵，让图面带印刷和手账氛围；保持面孔及笔画清晰。
rules.en: Add fine, subtle grain and a pale dot pattern to background and paper for a printed scrapbook feel, preserving clear faces and lettering.
rules.check: 近看有颗粒，缩小后点纹不夺焦。

rules.zh: 为{{mascots}}采用相似的轮廓语法和多种表情或动作；用{{accents}}在其间重复主题线索。
rules.en: Give {{mascots}} a shared silhouette grammar and varied expressions or poses. Repeat thematic cues through {{accents}} between them.
rules.check: 可辨同族角色及动作差异，装饰主题与活动一致。

rules.zh: 外围疏密交替，角色贴纸和小饰件团聚但不填满所有空隙；主标题和面孔周围保留读图区。
rules.en: Alternate denser and sparser zones at the edges, with clusters of stickers and small ornaments separated by clear gaps around headline and faces.
rules.check: 密集处集中在边缘与交叠节点，面孔与主字不被遮住。

rules.zh: 先读大标题，再看中心画面；如有补充信息，把{{labels}}放在承载纸件的清楚空位，文字短且级别低于标题。
rules.en: Make the headline the first read and the central image the second. If secondary information is present, place {{labels}} on a clear part of the carrying paper with short copy and lower prominence.
rules.check: 缩略图先读标题及图像，短文案在展开后清楚可读。

rules.zh: 用照片的真实面孔对比图标的夸张动作，用斜排标题对比规则点阵，形成轻快的邀请感。
rules.en: Contrast lifelike faces with exaggerated sticker poses, and tilted lettering with a regular dot grid, for a lively invitation.
rules.check: 将画面看成邀请卡时，两个对照都仍可察觉。
